per.title: person
per.description: name of a person (real or fictional), without titles such as Mr or President

loc.title: location
loc.description: country, city, region, geographic place; NOT when the place name stands for a sports team

org.title: organization
org.description: company, government body, political party, agency, institution, club, and sports teams even when named only by their city or country (e.g. in results tables); a preceding country or possessive is not part of the name
counter_examples: Japan 's Economic Planning Agency (tag Japan and Economic Planning Agency separately)

misc.title: miscellaneous
misc.description: other proper names: nationality or demonym adjectives, languages, religions, named events and competitions, named products and titles of works; NOT dates, weekdays, months, job titles or common nouns
